description_en: Lists files in a media fingerprint library
name: ListDNAFiles

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken

parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单页数据个数，默认为20，最大100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media fingerprint library
parameters.name: db_id
